author: PrinceRelyt
body:
Hello,

   Hi there! I'm from the Overcast Network and decided to switch over to Avicus! I consider myself pretty good at PvP (5KD). I joined quite some time ago on here (About 1 year ago), but never really played much before. If you don't know already, I've created the map Campi Erbosi for Nebula. So, anyway, feel free to ask me anything! :D
